gaps.explanation: The statement (p5, printed p18) is on the modified accrual basis. The Street, Sales Tax and Debt Service schedules are 'Budgetary Comparison Schedule - Cash Basis' (pp13-15, printed pp56-58). Fund by fund: General 833,524 = departments pp17-18. Debt Service 4 = 4. Other Funds 140,606 = nonmajor p16 (2,364 + 14 + 450 + 35,396 + 98,332 + 4,050). Street Fund: statement 308,093 (interest income 43,818) vs cash Total resources 304,817 (p13, interest income 40,542) = -3,276. Sales Tax Fund: statement 197,825 (interest income 13,467) vs cash Total resources 196,121 (p14, interest income 11,763) = -1,704. 3,276 + 1,704 = 4,980, the full gap. The difference is accrued vs cash interest.

General 776,929 and Other Funds 119,187 (19,377 + 1,219 + 98,241 + 350, p16) agree. Street Fund: statement public works 133,404 (p5) vs cash Total charges to appropriations 131,288 (p13) = -2,116. Debt Service Fund: statement 137,428 (p5: 1,154 + 130,000 + interest 6,274) vs cash 137,614 (p15: 1,154 + 130,000 + interest 6,460) = +186. -2,116 + 186 = -1,930, so the schedule is short by the full gap of 1,930. These are budgetary cash-basis vs modified-accrual differences.

The statement transfers_out 34,515 is the Total Governmental Funds net 'Transfer from (to) other funds' (34,515) on p5, i.e. the net transfer to the enterprise funds. detail[] records transfers gross per fund and per General Fund department as printed. Transfers out are: General Fund department General -509,706 (p17) and Airport -34,515 (p18), Street Fund -22,099 (p13), Sales Tax Fund -142,654 (p14) and LB840 Fund -6,219 (p16), totalling 715,193. They are offset by transfers in printed within the governmental funds: General Fund departments 92,015 + 7,996 + 134,879 + 97,205 + 122,252 + 43,847 + 35,131 + 3,524 = 536,849, Debt Service 137,610 and CDBG 6,219, totalling 680,678. 715,193 - 680,678 = 34,515. The printed fund columns tie: General -7,372, Street -22,099, Debt Service 137,610, Sales Tax -142,654, Other 0. Detail is gross and the Total column is net, so the difference is not an error.
